key_insight: FoG trains knowledge-graph agents to retrieve supporting triples, making factual answers traceable rather than merely correct.
engineering_relevance: Evidence-aware training can help engineers build auditable question-answering systems backed by retrieved knowledge-graph facts.
method: Synthesize evidence-grounded questions by recursively replacing explicit entities with verifiable sub-questions.
Record the triples returned during the agent’s knowledge-graph interactions.
Reward each supporting triple at the turn when the agent first retrieves it.
evidence_signal: Across three KGQA benchmarks, the abstract reports that 3B–4B open-source agents outperform substantially larger baselines in answer accuracy and evidence coverage, with zero-shot cross-KG transfer.
watch_item: Implementation requires reliable supporting-triple annotations and retrieval logs; the abstract does not quantify their construction cost or robustness to incomplete graphs.
paper_title: Clearing the FoG: Training KG Agents to Retrieve the Evidence Behind Their Answers
